entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI) is located in Izatnagar, Bareilly in the state of Uttar Pradesh. It is an advanced research facility specializing in veterinary medicine and allied fields. The institute also has regional campuses in Mukteshwar, Bengaluru, Palampur, Pune, Kolkata, and Srinagar.
